title: Get my Today briefing
description: The current user's Today briefing for this project, as shown on the Today home page: a short text about the self-driving reports that need them most (reports that wait for them, that they claimed or review, and urgent reports nobody owns), plus up to 5 items with a label, a signal and a link. A new one is written every morning from 8:00 local time. The first call of the day starts generation and returns status "collecting"; while a refresh is being written, the ready briefing comes back with status "writing" and its text. Generation takes a few minutes; call again later for the "ready" text. 404 when the person gets no briefing (flag off, AI data processing not approved, or out of AI credits); show the inbox reports instead. Use this to answer "what should I look at today?".

methodDocumentation.text: Today's personal briefing: a short text about up to 5 items and the same items for the left bar. A new one is written every morning from 8:00 local time. Starts generating today's when there is none yet and returns it as 'collecting'. While a refresh is being written, the ready briefing is returned as 'writing', so it can stay on screen; poll again after a few seconds. 404 when the person gets no briefing: the flag is off, the organization has not approved AI data processing, or it is out of AI credits.
